# Contributing

Thanks for contributing to Strata Pro Crypto UI.

## Local Setup

```bash
bun install
bun run dev
```

## Before Opening A PR

```bash
bun run lint
bun run build
```

## Contribution Guidelines

- Keep changes focused and easy to review.
- Preserve the existing visual language unless the change intentionally evolves it.
- Include screenshots or a short video for UI changes.
- Update docs when setup, behavior, or repository structure changes.
- Prefer small follow-up issues over bundling unrelated cleanup into one PR.

## Good First Contributions

- Accessibility improvements for data-dense components
- Additional dashboard states and empty/loading patterns
- More reusable chart and table primitives
- Documentation and screenshot upgrades
